event.title: Musk ordered to attend voter lottery hearing
event.summary_html:
A Philadelphia judge issues an order requiring Musk to appear in person at a hearing regarding a $1 million-per-day voter lottery scheme, which the Philadelphia District Attorney characterizes as an illegal lottery.

The court moves the hearing up by one day, stating,

It is further ordered that all parties must be present at the time of the hearing.

facts: In late Oct 2024, a Philadelphia judge issues an order in the civil case brought by the Philadelphia District Attorney over a $1 million-per-day voter lottery associated with Musk.
The DA’s suit characterises the prize scheme as an illegal lottery under applicable law.
The court moves the hearing up by one day.
The order requires Musk to appear in person at the hearing.
The written order states that all parties must be present at the time of the hearing.
Reuters reports the order on 30 Oct 2024 (via CNBC legal coverage syndication).
